### <i class="fa-solid fa-briefcase"></i> Employment and Experiences

| **Data Science Practicum, KSE Institute (MAY 2026 - JUL 2026)**
| Sole researcher on a project studying State Audit Service inspections of Prozorro tenders; built the full pipeline from data collection to a working scoring model.
| • **Procurement Risk Model:** built an ML model that ranks Prozorro tenders by the probability of a violation confirmed by the State Audit Service, trained on ~38k tenders, to prioritize audits under limited inspection capacity.
| • **Evaluation and Data Leakage Fix:** found data leakage and a broken contract-date field in the data pipeline, fixed them and re-evaluated the model on a clean out-of-time test set of 12.3k tenders.
| • **Tender Lookup Tool:** built a tool that scores any tender by ID and fetches newly published tenders live from the Prozorro API.
|
| **Freelance Data & Automation Developer (NOV 2025 - JAN 2026)**
| Sole developer of a production website for a retail business that aggregates product catalogs from multiple suppliers in one place; owned its database, data logic and automated updates.
| • **Supplier Data Aggregation:** built Python scrapers that collect products, prices and stock from supplier websites, many of which offered no API, into a single PostgreSQL database.
| • **Automated Catalog Updates:** ran the updates as scheduled cron jobs on Render; to stay within supplier request limits, split product categories into two groups refreshed on alternating days and timed the runs so update jobs never competed for database access.
| • **Reliability:** added detailed logging and wrote scripts to verify the database after each update run; refined the pipeline over several test iterations until prices and availability stayed current without manual intervention.
|
| **Technical Translator at Khan Academy (NOV 2024 - JAN 2025)**
| • **STEM Content Localization:** adapted high-level mathematics and science curricula for Ukrainian students, ensuring alignment with national technical terminology.
| • **Terminology Management:** developed and managed bilingual technical glossaries for mathematics to ensure consistency across the platform’s Ukrainian localization.
